revisions.change_summary: Description of change: New mandatory change assessment record for Pathways B and C. Captures change source, hold decision (Pathway C), design impact, risk determination, V&V determination, regulatory assessment (Letter-to-File or 510(k) retained in DHF), and routing to the DCO process. Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 1 sub-issues 1, 6, 7, 8, 9; FDA 483 Observation 2 and CAPA 2025-003 supplier change trigger; IA-2025 mNC 3.
